course.title: Django — From Beginner to Professional
course.description: A visual-first path through Django foundations, request/response architecture, views and templates, models and ORM, transactions, admin, forms, authentication, files, APIs, testing, security, performance, production deployment, advanced architecture, and clearly marked optional ecosystem specializations.
course.version_scope: Aligned to the supplied PDF snapshot of Django 6.1.2 released 2026-10-06, with official Django 6.1 documentation/release notes checked 2026-10-13. The PDF lists Python 3.12, 3.13, and 3.14 support for Django 6.1. Use an actively supported patch release and recheck security releases, Python/database compatibility and third-party dependencies before installation or publication.
prerequisites: Basic Python variables, data types, conditions, loops, functions, modules and object-oriented programming are recommended.
Basic HTML, HTTP request/response concepts, relational database concepts, command-line use and Git are helpful.
learning_outcomes: Create, configure, test, and explain Django projects and apps.
Build server-rendered pages and APIs with URL routing, views, templates, forms, and correct HTTP semantics.
Design models/relationships, use QuerySets effectively, manage migrations/transactions and build useful admin workflows.
Implement authentication, authorization, safe uploads, external integrations, privacy and security controls.
Test, profile, deploy, monitor, back up, and maintain Django applications using version-aware documentation.
Distinguish Django core features from optional third-party ecosystem tools and document their operational dependencies.

sections_reviewed: A: Course Overview and version statement
